title: feat(objectql)!: a flow, a webhook, a connector and an email template hold one name per package (bare-name phase 1, 3/4)
body:
Refs #30803 (PR 3 of 4 — flow, webhook, connector, email_template)

domain:server#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcTJTE7kSbcMoJQ4Txf

PR 1 was #30836 (the data family), PR 2 #31006 (the request family); the last PR of the series carries the card's closing line.

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the engine's package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`) and item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) refuse, after the cold boot, a package registration they accepted before: one whose flow, webhook, connector or email template bears a name another installed package holds. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` does not teach that two packages may share a flow, webhook, connector or email template name, and the naming rule itself is phase 2's (#30805); the prescription ships in the refusal and warning text and in ADR-0048's 2026-11-06 addendum (P1.8).

⚠️ **Tier H**: this diff touches `docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md` (header, §3.4 note, P1.5, P1.6 and the new P1.8). The seat routes the approver.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：裁决 C 第一阶段的第三族。冷启动结束后，flow、webhook、connector、email template 这四类名字，一个部署只认一个包：安装门和注册口拒绝第二个包，422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`，点出两个持有包和改名建议（与 #30836、#31006 同一机制，不另起一套）。
- 为什么改：实测两包同名——自动化引擎只武装一个 flow（包 id 字典序靠前者，有告警），`/meta/flow/NAME` 却给先注册包的声明；webhook 派发只订阅先注册包的声明，另一个永不触发，无告警；`/meta/connector/NAME`（设计器的连接器选择器读的门）给先注册包的描述；邮件发送 `template: NAME` 解析先注册包的模板。启动后再装一个同名包，今天照常 200 并被静默遮蔽。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄接受集，不改任何已存数据；平台内置邮件模板包（`com.objectstack.service.email`）按既有契约（ADR-0131 D6，应用同名模板覆盖内置）被排除为"可覆盖基线"，既不持有名字也不被拒。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`（四类加入列表、`OVERRIDABLE_BASELINE_PACKAGES`）、`registry.ts` 的 `bareNamePackageHolders` / `sealBareNameHolders`（邮件模板 `pkg:name@locale` 键的成员剥离，是最有风险的 hunk）、ADR-0048 P1.8。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts` ——预期 54 passed；或看 dogfood 文件 `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.dogfood.test.ts` 的四个用例。
- 需要你做的：ADR 改动是 Tier H，需要审批人批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`** — the covered types grow from six to ten: the registry types `flow`, `webhook`, `connector` and `email_template`, listed after the request family (`BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES` is now the one ordered list, `BARE_NAME_REGISTRY_TYPES` derived from it); their collection keys, labels (`email template`), consumer clauses and nouns, so a refusal's reason names what each consumer resolves. New **`OVERRIDABLE_BASELINE_PACKAGES`** / `isOverridableBaseline(type, packageId)`: per type, the packages whose items a consumer serves any other package's same-named item over by contract — today the email service's built-in templates (`com.objectstack.service.email`, `EmailServicePlugin.init`). `declaredBareNames` reads the manifest's id and declares nothing of a type the package is the baseline of. Module doc: the four measurements, the baseline, what is not judged.
- **`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`** — `bareNamePackageHolders` and `sealBareNameHolders` read a bundled type's key through `bundleBaseKey` (`pkg:name@locale` holds the NAME), and the holder list drops a type's baseline package; the item seam skips a baseline package's own registration. Comments name the ten types.
- **`packages/objectql/src/index.ts`** — exports `OVERRIDABLE_BASELINE_PACKAGES`, so the booted pin can hold its spelling of the email service's package equal to the package the email plugin registers the built-ins under (read back from the registry; neither package imports the other).
- **`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`** — the seal's comment names the ten types; no code change.
- **`docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md`** (Tier H) — the header's Addenda entry and §3.4's 2026-11-06 note name the ten types and the baseline; P1.5 keeps `agent` and `skill` as the last family; P1.6 names the baseline; new **P1.8** — the measurement, what is refused (the bundle, the connector kinds), the overridable baseline, what is not judged (the ADR-0146 declared override, ADR-0097's duplicate at boot, the kernel `metadata` service), the cold boot.
- **`scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__bare-name-one-holder.ts.json`** — the invariant names the third family and its served holder, the bundle reading and the baseline exclusion. Same ADR citations.
- **`.changeset/30803-bare-name-flow-family.md`** — `@objectstack/objectql` `minor`, both declaration lines, BREAKING Before / Now / The overridable baseline / The cold boot / Who moves / Unchanged, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, measured producers.

## Why (measured)

Booted showcase + two `AppPlugin` packages (`com.qa.bare.alpha`, `com.qa.bare.beta`) sharing one name per type, in both registration orders, on `24bc2593`; then `POST /marketplace/install-local` of a third package (`gamma`) declaring all four held names:

| Type | Consumer | Served | Warned | Post-boot third package today |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `flow` | automation engine (`getFlow`, the bare-name flow map via `resolveFlowPrecedence`) | `alpha` in BOTH orders (lexicographically-first package id) | yes, naming both | `200`, shadowed |
| `flow` | `GET /meta/flow/NAME` | first-registered (`alpha` in alpha→beta, `beta` in beta→alpha) — so in one order the designer's body and the running body come from two packages | no | — |
| `webhook` | `declaredWebhooks.declaredWebhookNamed` (the dispatcher's reader) and `GET /meta/webhook/NAME` | first-registered; the other is never subscribed | no | `200`, never subscribed |
| `connector` (descriptor) | `GET /meta/connector/NAME` (the picker's read); `listItems` returns both | first-registered | no | `200`, shadowed |
| `connector` (provider-bound instance) | automation service reconcile | the boot is REFUSED: `duplicate declarative connector instance name 'qa_shared_conn_live' — connector names must be unique (ADR-0097)` | loud (fatal) | after the boot: logged at `error`, skipped (code reading) |
| `email_template` | `email.renderTemplate({ template })` and `GET /meta/email_template/NAME` | first-registered | no | `200`, shadowed |

The showcase boot also showed the built-in `auth.password_reset` bundle registered under `com.objectstack.service.email` only (four locales) — the showcase itself declares no override; the email plugin's loader serves any other package's same-named member over the built-in by contract, which is why that package is the overridable baseline rather than a holder.

## Verification

- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts` (new, 54 cells, real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`): for each of the four types the data family's matrix — package door (both holders, rename, no record left), ABLATION before the seal, item seam, nested plugin, same-package reload (CONTROL), uninstall releases, environment registration never judged and never a holder (CONTROL), the cold boot (warns once naming both and the rename; reload keeps both, a third refused naming both; `'refuse'` refuses with the doors' envelope). Family-specific: the type list and its order; `declaredBareNames` over the four collections and a nested plugin, a bundle read once; a descriptor and a provider-bound connector instance hold the name alike; an email template's bundle is one holder and another package's member of that name is one conflict on the name; the item seam judges every member of a bundle; a holder is read from its member key alone (no claim) and the cold boot reads a bundled clash from the member keys; the baseline vocabulary; CONTROLs — an app overriding a built-in template after the boot installs and a second app is refused naming the first app only, the baseline package is refused nothing at either door, the cold boot of the baseline beside an app's override is no clash, two apps overriding one built-in name warn naming the two apps and never the baseline; the reason names only the types the refusal carries; a built-in flow name is refused at the package door.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.dogfood.test.ts` (new, booted showcase + two `AppPlugin` packages + `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin`): the cold boot boots and logs ONE `WARN` line naming the flow, the webhook, the connector and the email template, both packages and the renames, never the built-in bundle or its package, while the automation engine's own flow-collision warning still arms `alpha`; `POST /marketplace/install-local` of a third package declaring the held flow name is `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` naming both holders and `gamma_…`, the package list unchanged and the armed flow untouched; a package declaring the held webhook name plus the showcase's own flow and email template names is refused naming the showcase; CONTROL: fresh names install, and so does a package overriding the built-in `auth.password_reset` — the send then renders the app's subject, the built-in bundle still registered beside it, and the vocabulary's spelling of the baseline package equals the package the email plugin registered the built-ins under. 4 passed; the data and request families' dogfood files beside it 8 passed; `email-template-materialization.dogfood.test.ts` (a fixture app shipping `auth.password_reset` at boot) 4 passed.
- Ablations (src), each restored with `git diff HEAD` empty on the path: the four types removed from `BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES` → 39 of 54 cells red; the baseline exclusion removed from the holder reading → the 3 baseline CONTROLs red (an app's override refused naming the baseline; the cold boot warns about it); the bundle member no longer stripped from the key → the 2 member-key cells red.
- Ablation (dist): objectql built from the merge base's three sources (`ablation-dist-preflight --absent`: marker absent from all 14 built files) → the dogfood pin 4 of 4 red (no warning line; `gamma` and `delta` install-local answered `200` and installed; the CONTROL's import undefined); rebuilt from HEAD (marker present in 8 built files, tree clean) → 4 of 4 green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` exit 0 (incl. `check:test-typecheck`: 39 files / 233 errors / 64 pinned signatures held, unchanged); `@objectstack/dogfood` `tsc --noEmit` exit 0.
- Full suites, under `os-verify-lock` at `e01df46c`: `@objectstack/objectql` → 565 files / 11476 tests passed (`VERDICT command-exit 0`); `@objectstack/runtime` (the install-local and `AppPlugin` doors' caller) → 553 files / 8882 passed, 19 skipped (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` at `e01df46c`: 82 derived families, every one run with its exit code captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: "82 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 82 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED" (exit 0). Two needed a rerun after a prerequisite, as PR 1 met: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (seven packages had no `dist/` on this fresh worktree: studio, client-react, embedder-openai, knowledge-memory, knowledge-ragflow, service-cluster-redis, service-knowledge) → built them under the lock, rerun exit 0 (116 entry points / 71 packages load); `pnpm check:type-check-debt` exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (its closure build never got a turn on the shared verify lock behind the dogfood battery) → rerun under the lock, exit 0 (`--re-measure: OK — 0 ledger entries re-measured, 0 raw tsc errors, none above its recorded number`). Local-only families (`check:dev-prereqs`, `check:skill-frame-freshness`) not derived for this diff.
- `pnpm lint` at `e01df46c`: exit 0 (captured before any pipe).
- Full dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, under `os-verify-lock`) at `e01df46c`: `VERDICT command-exit 0` · Test Files 435 passed | 3 skipped (438) · Tests 3600 passed | 41 skipped (3641) · no failures (held the lock 1189s on a shared box).

## Kept

- Same-name actions on different objects (`objectName:name`), jobs keyed `appId:jobName`, the unmanaged import's all-type refusal, the environment catalog (ADR-0005 overlay) and the ADR-0146 declared override of a base flow (a stored row); the automation service's own ADR-0097 duplicate refusal at boot; every data- and request-family pin green unchanged (`registry-bare-name-one-holder.test.ts`, `…-request-family.test.ts`, `hook-binder.test.ts` — 100 cells).

## Acceptance notes

- The measurement per type is the table above; the card's audit row for `flow` ("one armed, warning logged") holds, and the second consumer (`/meta/flow/NAME`) adds a silent split in one order.
- Not judged (stated in the module doc and P1.8): the kernel `metadata` service's `(type, name)` overwrite — on the composed runtime none of the four is read through it (the webhook reader falls back to it only with no registry).
- `GET /connectors` answered `404` on the showcase composition during the measurement (the route is not mounted there); the connector reading used `/meta/connector/NAME` and the registry list instead. Observation only.

## Series and out of scope

- PR4 (`agent`, `skill`, the card's closing line) follows this one; ADR-0048 P1.5 names it.
- A second app overriding a built-in template beside a first app's override is refused by this PR; whether the first app's override should itself be reported at boot (today: no warning, by the loader's contract) is left as the email plugin's own question.
